name: element_symbol
description: Map chemical element names to their standard symbols without arithmetic; matched controls copy supplied symbols.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
rows=list(zip(['hydrogen','helium','carbon','nitrogen','oxygen','sodium','chlorine','iron','copper','silver','gold','mercury','lead','tin','potassium','calcium','magnesium','aluminium','sulfur','phosphorus','zinc','silicon','neon','argon'],['H','He','C','N','O','Na','Cl','Fe','Cu','Ag','Au','Hg','Pb','Sn','K','Ca','Mg','Al','S','P','Zn','Si','Ne','Ar']))
items=[];control=[]
for name,symbol in rows:
 for template in ['What is the chemical symbol for {n}? Symbol:','Element: {n}. Write its standard chemical symbol only:','Chemistry quiz: {n} is represented by which symbol? Answer:','Give the periodic-table symbol of {n}. Symbol:']:
  items.append({'prompt':template.format(n=name),'answer':' '+symbol})
  s=random.choice(rows)[1];control.append({'prompt':f'Element: {name}. Printed symbol: {s}. Copy the printed symbol exactly. Symbol:','answer':' '+s})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
